# Quantify Terminal

> Terminals tell you what happened. Quantify Terminal tells you what changed because it happened. When a filing or a macro print lands, Quantify Terminal proposes the model changes with the source attached to every changed number, the assumptions behind your thesis move, and your portfolio exposure is recomputed and recorded.

For analysts and portfolio managers who maintain their own models. Desktop terminal for macOS, Windows and Linux.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/): what it does, how it works in five steps, the thesis object, provenance, the desk, role templates, agents, the Data Fabric, proof.
- [What changed today](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/what-changed-today): the format the daily public brief will take, and the ninety-second walkthrough. Briefs begin with the next release.
- [Product](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/product): the eight systems: Pulse, Deep Research, Financial Model Compiler, Thesis and Health, Portfolio Digital Twin, Decision Ledger and Replay, Scenario Lab and Red Team, agent access.
- [Vision](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/vision): the system that maintains conviction, not just information; what it is, the order it is built in, what it is not.
- [Pricing](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/pricing): early access for funds and investment teams.
- [Early access](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/early-access): the request form; access is by application for analysts and funds.
- [Download](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/download): desktop builds.
- [Agents](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/agents): an MCP server with ten read-only verbs for Claude and your own agents; the Python SDK over the same server, with an HTTP API being built next; and Excel and Google Sheets formulas.

## Proof and trust

- [Accuracy](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/accuracy): what is measured and when it abstains. The method is published; the numbers are not, and will not be invented.
- [Trust](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/trust): security, data handling, export formats, escrow.
- [Data rights](https://www.quantifyterminal.com/data-rights): display versus non-display, what the free tier is licensed for, how entitlements are enforced.
